game.name: Color Book
game.rules:
- Speedrun Mode must be used in all categories (create multiplayer lobby, tick "Speedrun Mode").

- Use in-game time when submitting your run (the one at the top of the screen, not the one in the chat message).

- FPS unlockers are not allowed. You are not allowed to change the FPS of Roblox beyond 60, even with the in-game FPS changer.
- As of the September 27th update to Color Book, all runs must clearly show the in-game framerate counter. ["Clearly", in this case, meaning "to a readable extent". Just don't completely obscure it.]

- Submissions with multiple players require all perspectives (every player must record).

- Recordings must show the lobby prior to starting.

- Solo runs in the top 3 submitted after July 13th, 2024 must show cursor; world record runs in multiplayer categories must have all POVs show cursor (mobile not included).
